The '''VX Hands-free weapon system''' was an [[armor accessory]] produced by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and cost 1,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. It allowed a weapon to fire hand-free.<ref name="DC" />
